name: Rotate-backlog creates the docs phase by default
objective: Change /rotate-backlog so it still archives every clean phase first, then by default turns the phases held back only by doc-consolidation debt into a proposed docs phase: it drafts that phase's name, objective and scope from docs-debt and asks the operator to confirm once; the yes runs new-phase and fills intent.md through create-phase's docs-phase route. An opt-out word (e.g. /rotate-backlog archive-only) keeps today's archive-and-report behavior.
